findings.title: Internal recovered condensate is subtracted twice from aggregate water balance
findings.description: The whole-plant equation subtracts all captured condensate independently of closing water stocks. Internal condensate recovered into the bath or retained in a tank is not an outward water stream and already enters stock/reuse. A 100 kg fresh water cohort with 20 kg retained captured condensate, 80 kg atmospheric net water and no other water outputs gives the authored formula 100-20-20=60 kg instead of 80 kg. The complete scope makes bath reuse internal (line72) and requires stocks (lines332/345); the equation does not condition condensate subtraction on outward transfer.
findings.minimum_correction: Subtract only captured condensate actually transferred across the declared control volume as a separately identified outgoing stream. Internally recovered/recirculated condensate cancels as an internal transfer; retained condensate enters closing stock exactly once. Apply both languages and regenerate projection.
evidence: Source conservation counterexample in finding; no empirical factor assumed
